name: Steam Glass
author: sanscura
description: Ink on paper. A Swiss-editorial Steam theme from Glass Dashboard: heavy uppercase type, hairline rules, pill controls and a prism accent, in Paper and Ink.

Mode.description: Paper is the light sheet, Ink is the dark one. Steam reloads its UI when you change this.

Prism accent.description: The rainbow gradient on progress bars, the active tab and the Play button. Off keeps the theme pure monochrome.
